more.desc: Dutchman Tree Farms has launched its holiday season by beginning the shipment of over 600,000 Christmas trees across the United States. Despite rising freight costs, co-owners Christopher and Sarah Maciborskis report strong crop quality due to favorable seasonal rainfall. MANTON-Dutchman Tree Farms in Manton has begun harvesting and shipping more than 600,000 Christmas trees across the country while opening its fields for choose-and-cut visitors. The farm is launching its holiday season following an unusually warm autumn across northern Michigan. Co-owners Christopher and Sarah Maciborskis report strong crop quality across their more than 6,000-acre agricultural operation. Plentiful rainfall during key growing months in the spring and summer helped offset later dry spells, supporting tree health ahead of nationwide distribution.
